options.why: A positive edge can still be needed to connect two components; sign alone does not reject it.
If both endpoints are already connected, adding the edge creates a cycle, including a self-loop when they coincide.
Input position does not determine usefulness; edges are considered by weight and component membership.
Different labels can be in the same component; find results, not raw labels, decide whether a cycle forms.

items.explanation: Would create a cycle or self-loop.
